name: genealogy-research
description: Deep research per ancestor in your own GEDCOM tree: fact checks against archive sources, records beyond baptism, marriage and burial, historical background, family completion, life stories and a life book. Includes the lineage CLI.

language.title: Output language
language.description: Default language for reports, life stories and CLI messages in new projects (ISO code, e.g. en or nl). Each project can override it in lineage.toml.

runner.title: Runner
runner.description: How research rounds and helper agents run: auto (Herdr when available, otherwise inline), herdr, headless or inline.
